concerns.text: T018 mandates generating 'gas-phase minimized conformations' via RDKit ETKDG and explicitly forbids using CIF coordinates. This contradicts spec FR-004 which requires 3-D descriptors 'derived from the CIF coordinates'. The task silently relaxes the data source constraint, altering the feature definition without spec authorization.

T025 defines the architecture as 'Input -> Hidden(64) -> Hidden(32) -> Output', which constitutes a 3-layer network (two hidden layers). Spec FR-005 mandates a '2-layer MLP' (implying one hidden layer). This violates the architectural constraint in the spec.

T040 introduces 'conformational ensemble' generation (10-20 conformers) and 'dipole moment' calculation. The spec defines the input as 'SMILES representations' and target as 'CAPE' derived from static data; no FR authorizes ensemble generation or dipole moments. This is a scope violation introducing unrequested work.

T042 attempts to extract 'pressure' from CIF metadata. Spec FR-013 and the Assumptions section only list 'lattice system, measurement temperature, presence of solvent' as available confounders. COD CIFs typically lack pressure fields for organic crystals. This task attempts to implement a feature not supported by the spec's data model.

T027 states: 'Shuffle labels [deferred] times'. Spec FR-016 and FR-006 explicitly mandate '10,000' shuffles. Using a placeholder '[deferred]' for a fixed statistical parameter violates the deterministic constraint in the spec.
